products.name: e-VOA, Electronic Visa on Arrival
products.short_description: A 30-day Indonesian tourist visa you get before you fly to Bali. You skip the airport VOA queue and go straight to the immigration counter when you land.
products.description:
Who it is for

Citizens of the countries on the Visa on Arrival list of Indonesian Immigration.

What we need from you

  • Your passport Valid for at least 6 more months. A clear photo of the main page is enough.
  • A photo of you A clear photo of the passport holder.
  • Your onward flight ticket The ticket out of Indonesia.

What the price includes

  • The e-VOA application Prepared and submitted by our team in Balangan.
  • The government e-VOA charge Nothing more to pay at the airport for the visa itself.

How it works

  1. Pay online Apply on this page. You can also message us first if you are unsure.
  2. Send your documents Send your required documents via WhatsApp or email. We’ll prepare your application.
  3. We apply for you We submit the application and keep you updated on WhatsApp.
  4. Fly to Bali Your e-VOA arrives by email. Show it at the immigration counter when you land.

Good to know

Can I extend the e-VOA?

Yes, once, for another 30 days, so you can stay up to 60 days in total. We handle the VOA extension too.

When should I apply?

Before you fly. Processing takes 1 to 2 working days, and Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays are not counted.

I want to stay longer than 60 days

Then the C1 Tourist Visa fits better: 60 days on arrival, extendable to 180 days.

products.name: VOA Extension
products.short_description: Adds 30 more days to your Visa on Arrival. A VOA can be extended once, and the extension is issued as an electronic stay permit.
products.description:
Who it is for

Anyone in Indonesia on an active VOA or e-VOA (index B1).

What we need from you

  • Your valid visa The VOA or e-VOA you entered Indonesia with.
  • Your e-stay permit The electronic stay permit that came with it.
  • A recent photo of you A colour passport-style photo.

What the price includes

  • The application documents Prepared by our team.
  • The government fee (PNBP) Paid by us as part of the application.
  • Flexible scheduling We book your biometrics and photo at the immigration office at a time that suits you.
  • VIP accompaniment A member of our team is with you at the immigration office.

How it works

  1. Pay online Apply on this page. You can also message us first if you are unsure.
  2. Send your documents Send your required documents via WhatsApp or email. We’ll prepare your application.
  3. We apply for you We submit the application and keep you updated on WhatsApp.
  4. Receive your visa Your e-Visa or official Stay Permit letter will be sent directly to you. No passport stamping required.

Good to know

When should I apply?

Before your current stay permit expires. The extension can be finished after that date and you will not be fined.

Which days count as processing days?

Saturdays, Sundays, public holidays and days when the immigration system is down are not counted.

How do I receive the extension?

As an electronic stay permit. We send you the file; scanning its barcode opens your stay-permit details in the immigration system.

Can I cancel?

If you cancel an extension, the full price is charged.
